A feature is the path below \"features\": A feature is the path below "features", for example heating.dhw.temperature.main. "heating.dhw.*" matches heating.dhw and everything below it. Without * the name must match exactly.
A new client ID can take up to 15 minute: A new client ID can take up to 15 minutes until it works.
After saving, the adapter restarts and d: After saving, the adapter restarts and deletes all data points which the settings on this page exclude. Scripts and visualisations that use them will no longer get values.
Applied after the allowlist. Handy to dr: Applied after the allowlist. Handy to drop single large groups, such as the message lists below device.messages, and keep everything else.

Deletes existing data points which the s: Deletes existing data points which the settings on this page exclude, also the features of devices outside the device allowlist. Data points with own settings (for example history) are kept.
Device IDs separated by commas, for exam: Device IDs separated by commas, for example: 0, HeatDemandControl. Empty: all devices.
Events are the history of the installati: Events are the history of the installation, for example status changes and error messages. They are not needed for values and commands.
Every update costs one API call per devi: Every update costs one API call per device. The free Viessmann plan allows 1450 calls per day.
Every update costs one API call.
Example: one device every 2 minutes = 72: Example: one device every 2 minutes = 720 calls per day. The minimum is 0.5 minutes.
For example RoomControl. Without this op: For example RoomControl. Without this option they are read only once at adapter start.

No data points for feature, gatewayId, d: No data points for feature, gatewayId, deviceId, apiVersion, isEnabled, isReady, uri, the type of a property and the name and params of a command.
Only relevant for installations with sev: Only relevant for installations with several gateways. 1 = first online gateway.
Separated by commas, * allowed at the en: Separated by commas, * allowed at the end. Example: device.messages.*

The Viessmann API delivers thousands of: The Viessmann API delivers thousands of data points. The settings on this page reduce their number. The paths of the remaining data points do not change.
The adapter needs a client ID from the V: The adapter needs a client ID from the Viessmann developer portal. Create a client there with the name "iobroker", Google reCAPTCHA deactivated and the redirect URI http://localhost:4200/ and enter its client ID here.
The device ID is the name of the folder: The device ID is the name of the folder directly below the installation number. Fewer devices mean fewer API calls, which helps against the rate limit, for example with the ViCare single room control.
The folder \"events\" often contains mor: The folder "events" often contains more than a thousand data points.

Values (properties), timestamp and comma: Values (properties), timestamp and commands (uri, isExecutable, setValue) stay. For a heat pump this removes about half of all data points.

Without this option filtered data points: Without this option filtered data points stay with their last value and are not updated any more. If a filter is switched off again, the adapter creates the data points again at its next start.
